english.title: Fail to hand in property found within Gatwick Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), within Gatwick Airport - London, having found property, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PROPERTY..), to which the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 applied, failed to hand it, as soon as reasonably practicable and in the state in which you found it, to a member of staff of the airport, an airport official or constable and inform that person of the place and circumstances in which it was found
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 11(2) and 2(3) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
